summary: The failed-understanding retry path is untested: explicit Retry clears the save error without retrying the learner decision.
fix: Retain the failed explicit learner intent with its original participant, source hash and idempotency ID, and replay it only after the learner chooses Retry. Add a controller-level failure/recovery test that preserves the old checkbox while storage fails, then saves exactly one decision and updates the checkbox after explicit retry.
evidence: understand creates the decision inline in library.decide (224), but catch only reports "Not saved" and discards the intent (225). action(retry) deletes the progress error, then runs "this.progress = await this.library!.readProgress()" and retries only pendingArchives (196-198); it never calls decide. A deterministic harness executing the current methods injected failure on the first decide call, recovered storage, and invoked action(retry): decisionCallsAfterRetry=1, savedUnderstandingAfterRetry=false, errorsAfterRetry=[]. D6.3 specifies "Not saved" and Retry with prior persisted state retained, and extension/README.md describes Retry Study Storage as explicit recovery. learning.test.ts checks library failure/retained bytes, while webview QA checks only that clicking Retry emits its message; neither exercises the controller recovery end to end.
test_stub: test('retrying a failed understanding save persists the original learner choice once', async () => { /* Arrange readable progress with no decisions and a decide write that fails once. */ await assert.rejects(reader.understand(true), /storage failure/); assert.equal(reader.inspect().view.model.selectedUnderstanding.understood, false); await reader.action('retry'); const progress = await library.readProgress(); assert.equal(progress.decisions.length, 1); assert.equal(progress.decisions[0].item, 'server'); assert.equal(progress.decisions[0].sourceHash, originalServerHash); assert.equal(progress.decisions[0].understood, true); assert.equal(reader.inspect().view.model.selectedUnderstanding.understood, true); });
